```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required = set(case["required_symbols"])
    node_by_id = {}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        nid = n["id"]
        node_by_id[nid] = n
        children.setdefault(nid, [])
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children.setdefault(n["parent"], []).append(nid)
    sym_counts = {}
    for n in nodes:
        sym_counts[n["symbol"]] = sym_counts.get(n["symbol"], 0) + 1
    # sort by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    removed_set = set()
    removed_order = []
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n["id"]
        if not n["removable"] or nid == "root":
            continue
        # check if all children are removed
        child_list = children.get(nid, [])
        if any(c not in removed_set for c in child_list):
            continue
        sym = n["symbol"]
        if sym in required and sym_counts[sym] == 1:
            continue
        # remove
        removed_set.add(nid)
        removed_order.append(nid)
        sym_counts[sym] -= 1
    retained_ids = sorted([n["id"] for n in nodes if n["id"] not in removed_set])
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained_ids}
```
